title: Overview
description: Minerva is a UI library for the web: React components plus framework-agnostic Web Components, themable through CSS variables.

what.title: What is Minerva
what.p1: Minerva helps you build consistent, accessible interfaces quickly. It ships a React component library and a small set of Lit-based custom elements that are developed together in one monorepo and share the same design language.
what.p2: Every component reads its colors, radii and shadows from CSS custom properties, so switching between light, dark or your own brand theme is a pure CSS-variable swap without re-rendering.

packages.title: Packages
packages.core: React (18+) components, ConfigProvider, theme utilities and hooks. ESM + CommonJS with TypeScript types.
packages.webComponents: Framework-agnostic custom elements built with Lit, starting with <minerva-button>. Works in plain HTML, React, Vue and others.

theming.title: Themes
theming.text: light, dark and github-dark built in, "auto" mode that follows the operating system, and custom themes via ConfigProvider.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.text: The React library ships its own translations for English, Chinese, Japanese and French with a tiny built-in translator: no i18n library dependency, fully isolated from your app's i18n setup.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.text: semantic elements, keyboard support, visible focus rings and aria-label props for icon-only controls.

typescript.title: TypeScript
typescript.text: written in TypeScript; every component exports its props type, and themes are typed token maps.

modules.title: Tree-shakable builds
modules.text: ESM and CommonJS output with side-effect-free modules, plus one stylesheet to import.
